items.title: Brixmor Just Raised Its Dividend 7.3%. These 4 Retail REITs Offer Income Potential
items.summary: Grocery-anchored shopping centers are producing record occupancy numbers and double-digit rent spreads at a moment when almost no new space is being built. Four equity REITs are positioned to capture that landlord leverage, but their yields, payout cushions, and risks differ in ways that matter before you buy.
